name: Nikon NIS-Elements
description: 打开尼康 NIS-Elements 保存的 ND2，支持多位置、Z 栈、时间序列和多通道，并显示物镜、相机、激光和滤镜等采集参数
author: TifMrcView

en.name: Nikon NIS-Elements
en.description: Opens ND2 files saved by Nikon NIS-Elements, with multipoint positions, Z stacks, time series and channels, and shows the objective, camera, lasers, filters and other acquisition settings

zh: 打开尼康显微镜软件 NIS-Elements 保存的 ND2 文件（宽场、转盘共聚焦、A1/AX 激光共聚焦、明场彩色相机等）。TifMrcView 本身不带 ND2 读取代码；装上这个插件后即可打开 .nd2：多通道、Z 栈、时间序列都支持，多位置（XY 点）实验的每个位置作为一个单独的图像，可在图像列表里切换。未压缩和无损压缩的文件都能读；8 位、16 位和 32 位浮点数据，以及 8 位彩色图像都支持。插件以 WebAssembly 形式在沙箱里运行，只能读取正在打开的那个文件，像素的解压和通道拆分由应用本身并行完成，速度和内置格式一样。
插件还把文件里的元数据整理成采集参数，显示在图像信息面板里。「NIS 图像」：软件版本、采集时间、各维度尺寸、实验循环、位深、压缩方式、像素尺寸、Z 步长、时间间隔和载物台位置。「NIS 显微镜」：显微镜型号、物镜、放大倍数、数值孔径、折射率、变焦、针孔、相机和 Z 驱动，以及相机的分档、曝光、增益和温度等设置。
每个通道单独一组：显示颜色、成像模式（荧光、明场、转盘或激光共聚焦等）、激发与发射波长、荧光探针、滤镜、针孔、曝光时间、分档、开启的激光线和功率，以及 NIS-Elements 为这个通道记录的全部显微镜设置。「NIS 全部参数」把所有元数据展开列出，方便查找。
安装后无需设置，直接打开 .nd2 文件即可，状态栏会显示「Nikon ND2」和保存它的 NIS-Elements 版本。2007 年以前基于 JPEG 2000 的旧版 ND2 和有损压缩的 ND2 暂不支持。需要 TifMrcView 0.5.0 或更新版本。
en: Opens ND2 files saved by NIS-Elements, the software of Nikon microscopes (widefield, spinning disk, A1/AX laser scanning confocals, colour brightfield cameras and others). TifMrcView itself contains no ND2 code; with this plugin installed, .nd2 files open with channels, Z stacks and time series, and every stage position of a multipoint experiment becomes its own image that you can switch to. Uncompressed and losslessly compressed files are read, with 8-bit, 16-bit and 32-bit float data as well as 8-bit colour images. The plugin runs sandboxed as WebAssembly and can only read the file being opened; decompressing the pixels and splitting the channels is done by the app itself, in parallel, as fast as for built-in formats.

The plugin also turns the file's metadata into acquisition settings in the image-info panel. "NIS image": software version, acquisition time, size of every dimension, experiment loops, bit depth, compression, pixel size, Z step, time interval and stage position. "NIS microscope": microscope model, objective, magnification, numerical aperture, refractive index, zoom, pinhole, camera and Z drive, plus camera settings such as binning, exposure, gain and temperature.

Each channel gets its own group: display colour, modality (fluorescence, brightfield, spinning disk or laser scanning confocal…), excitation and emission wavelengths, fluorescent probe, filter, pinhole, exposure time, binning, the laser lines in use with their power, and every microscope setting NIS-Elements recorded for that channel. "NIS all settings" flattens every metadata field so you can search it.

There is nothing to configure: install it and open .nd2 files. The status bar then shows "Nikon ND2" with the NIS-Elements version that saved the file. Old JPEG 2000-based ND2 files (from before 2007) and lossy compressed ND2 files are not supported yet. Needs TifMrcView 0.5.0 or newer.
